name: El Hornillo (Spain)
description: Red field charged at a third of the length from the hoist with a white pillory column.
history: The flag, approved simultaneously with the arms (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 202 of 17 October 2001), is described as a municipal flag of 2:3 formed of a red cloth with a white pillory at a third of the length of the flag.
